# TestScript for 27-strict-tag-validation
# Asserts that StrictTagValidation(false) tolerates the third-party validate/db
# tag keys: the schema builds and runs normally, while the default strict mode
# would reject them with an ErrSchema error before Run.

# 1. The schema builds despite the foreign tags; CONGA values resolve normally
exec strict-tags --email ops@example.com
stdout '⚙  strict-tags'
stdout '--email\s+string\s+ops@example\.com\s+● cli --email'
stdout '--retries\s+int\s+3\s+· default'

# 2. Third-party tags are inert: they never surface in help or the inspector
exec strict-tags --help
! stdout 'validate'
! stdout 'db:'
